_doc: Human-owned ground truth. The machine must never grade its own misses (VCST-5776 §D5: the human owns the goldens), so nothing in this toolchain writes this file. `expect` names the entry that ANSWERS the question; `must` is a verbatim marker that entry must still contain, which is what makes the set catch its own staleness under `--check`.

goldens.q: does the cart show tax before a shipping address is entered
how many failed sign-in attempts lock an account
which control adds a product to the cart on the product detail page
when is a minimum order quantity violation reported
